statement: Entering a Freeze effect freezes the entering piece; the Freeze cell is consumed, and the piece cannot move on its next turn but can move on the following turn.
trigger: A piece enters a Freeze effect cell.
effect: The cell is used up and the piece is frozen, so its attempted move on its next turn is refused; it may move the turn after that.

statement: With the same initial board and script, build-800c grants Human four actions at the start of Human turns, while build-c602 grants Human three; AI is granted three in both observed runs.
trigger: A turn starts in the matched S-4251 scripted setup.
effect: Human is granted 4 actions in build-800c and 3 in build-c602; the observed AI turns receive 3 in each build.
evidence: C-fdc5cf turns 1, 3, 5, and 7; C-134dcb turns 1, 3, 5, and 7.
